svg.title: What happens when an agent runs
svg.desc: 1, Pin everything: The exact Genome, World, task, code version, and budget are fixed before anything runs. 2, Lock it in: A private copy of the code in a macOS sandbox. Only its own folder is writable; no network unless allowed. 3, Run it: The built-in test runner today. Claude Code and Codex runners exist and are opt-in. 4, Sign the result: Output and time are capped. The daemon signs what happened and files the evidence. Hosts without a verified sandbox refuse to run agents at all.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
